policy: Fixed depth eight and hidden/channel ratio four. Fresh random models use the original first source stage, replay, speech and AdamW policy. Candidate core rates scale inversely with channel width relative to 256; the output normalization and vocabulary head keep the original rate. This is a simple rate control, not maximal update parametrization or biological homeostasis.
limits: Exploratory early-learning screen after seeing the original regression. Sampled parameter coordinates are not complete tensor norms. Live source caches precede that source update; sampled gradients have already been clipped. Instrumented timing is not a production speed benchmark. Early quality and activity are not proof of lifelong retention, useful QA or reproductive fitness. No default is promoted.
